voodoo.desc: When Bad Juju is used on enemies affected by Puppeteer's Threads, it strikes an additional time every 1 sec for 30% of the damage dealt over 3 seconds as Nature damage.

voodoo.name: Hollow Spirit
voodoo.desc: Damage dealt by Shadowflare and Hexfire now increases the chance enemies are critically struck by 3% for 12 seconds.

voodoo.name: It's Da Voodoo
voodoo.desc: Increases the damage of Shadowflare by 0%.
